components.name: Primary CTA Button
components.description: High-confidence action for starting consultation or saving workflow progress.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 46px; padding: 0 22px; border: 0; border-radius: 14px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-navy) 0%, #0b4abf 100%); color: #fff; font: 700 13px var(--font-ui); cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 16px 30px rgba(11, 74, 191, 0.25); transition: transform 0.18s ease, box-shadow 0.18s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(201, 168, 76, 0.45); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Quiet secondary action for navigation or learning more.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 46px; padding: 0 22px; border: 1px solid #cbd9ec; border-radius: 14px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.84); color: #0b3670; font: 700 13px var(--font-ui); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.18s ease, border-color 0.18s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); border-color: rgba(201, 168, 76, 0.65); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(201, 168, 76, 0.35); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Evidence Card
components.description: Source-backed answer or reference surface with calm containment.
components.html:
Jawaban berbasis rujukan

Sistem menampilkan sumber agar pengguna dapat memeriksa kembali konteks dokumen.
components.css: .ds-evidence-card { border: 1px solid #dce6f3; border-radius: 18px; background: #fff; color: #27384f; padding: 17px; font: 13px/1.65 var(--font-ui); box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgba(12, 43, 84, 0.06); } .ds-evidence-card strong { display: block; color: #0b3670; font-weight: 800; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-evidence-card p { margin: 0; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Compact government-form field for login, chat, and document workflows.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; font-family: var(--font-ui); } .ds-field span { color: var(--color-navy); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.5px; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid #d0d0d0; border-radius: 3px; background: #faf9f7; color: var(--color-text); font: 14px var(--font-ui); } .ds-field input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--color-gold); background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(201, 168, 76, 0.1); }

components.name: Top Navigation
components.description: Dark navy product shell navigation with compact account and section links.
components.css: .ds-topbar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 10px 32px; background: var(--color-navy); color: #fff; font-family: var(--font-ui); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(201, 168, 76, 0.25); } .ds-logo { width: 34px; height: 34px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--color-gold); color: var(--color-navy); font: 700 15px var(--font-display); } .ds-topbar strong { margin-right: auto; font: 700 16px var(--font-display); } .ds-topbar a { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.62); font-size: 11px; padding: 5px 10px; border-radius: 2px; } .ds-topbar a.active { color: var(--color-gold); }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Small operational state badge for API health, document indexing, and source availability.
components.css: .ds-status-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 22px; padding: 3px 8px; border: 1px solid #a3d9b9; border-radius: 999px; background: #edf7f2; color: #2d7a4f; font: 800 11px var(--font-ui); letter-spacing: 0.3px; }

narrative.overview: The interface should feel like an internal government reading room: orderly, quiet, trustworthy, and ready for careful work. It is not a public marketing site and it is not an AI novelty surface. The design serves legal consultation, source review, document management, and accountable internal workflows.
keyCharacteristics: Formal, calm, and trustworthy before expressive or playful.
Source-first: visual hierarchy should lead users toward rujukan, evidence, and verification.
Restrained color: navy carries structure, gold marks importance, white/cream preserve reading comfort.
Product consistency over surprise: repeated controls should look and behave the same across Home, Chat, Login, and Documents.
Accessible by default: strong contrast, keyboard-visible states, reduced motion alternatives, and clear Bahasa Indonesia.

rules.name: The Rujukan Before Accent Rule
rules.body: Gold and blue accents are earned by source, state, or primary action. Decoration alone does not earn accent color.

rules.name: The Muted Text Rule
rules.body: ink-light is prohibited for required instructions, labels, or legal caveats. Use ink-muted at minimum, and move toward ink when contrast is uncertain.

rules.name: The Product Label Rule
rules.body: Uppercase labels are allowed only for short operational markers such as status, stepper labels, and metadata. Body copy must never be uppercase.

rules.name: The One Hero Rule
rules.body: Only the main page hero may use the strongest shadow and largest radius. Reusing hero treatment on every section makes the product feel decorative.

rules.name: The Border First Rule
rules.body: Dense product workflows start with borders and tonal layers. Add shadow only when hierarchy or overlay behavior needs it.

dos: Do keep the interface formal, calm, and trustworthy. Product UI must serve legal/SPBE work before visual novelty.
Do use navy for structure, gold for rare institutional emphasis, and white/cream for reading surfaces.
Do make rujukan and evidence visible before confidence. If an answer has sources, the UI should guide the user toward them.
Do maintain WCAG AA as the minimum for text contrast, keyboard focus, semantic structure, and reduced motion.
Do document every new reusable pattern in the same visual vocabulary: button, card, status, table, source panel, and form control.
donts: Don't create a generic AI SaaS look: gradient-heavy hero sections, endless identical card grids, buzzword copy, or decorative glass effects.
Don't make the interface too busy. Decoration, animation, and novelty must never distract from legal text and source review.
Don't make authenticated internal screens feel like public/commercial marketing pages.
Don't hide accountability. Disclaimers, source state, retrieval state, and legal limitations must remain visible.
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored stripe on cards, suggestions, or alerts. Replace with full borders, background tint, icons, or structured metadata.
Don't animate layout dimensions such as width/height for routine progress or navigation state. Use transform, opacity, or instant state changes.
Don't rely on low-opacity white text for essential nav/account information. If users need it, it must be readable.
